title: Charting the European LLM Benchmarking Landscape: A New Taxonomy and a Set of Best Practices
reasoning: The paper proposes a new taxonomy for LLM evaluation that explicitly includes 'Machine ethics' (Category 3.4) as a core subcategory of 'Safety and Trustworthiness'. This category is defined as assessing a model's adherence to ethical principles and its capacity for moral reasoning in responses.
